summary: One member cooks a meal for a family every Friday because of their health.
realLife: The same interview mentions a church member who cooks a meal for a family each Friday because of the family's health situation.
sources: Orlando Memory, deaconess oral history interview: https://orlandomemory.org/people/deaconess-lillian-lancaster-mt-zion-missionary-baptist-institutional-church-oral-history-interview/
inGame: an illness record plus a recurring favor; needs: a recurring help record between households

turns.summary: The Friday meal continues until the family recovers.
turns.writesBack: deep tie; the family owes a debt of thanks

turns.summary: The meals stop when life gets busy.
turns.writesBack: quiet hurt; no one says anything
